local selectFunction = select

local function writeVariadicValues(target, idx, ...)
    local va = {...}

    for i = 1, selectFunction('#', ...)do
        target[idx + i - 1] = va[i]
    end
end

    local function handler(iteratorData)
        local number = 0
        local data = nil

        while number ~= 1 do
            if number == 0 then

                repeat

                        for key, item in iterator, state do
                            data[key] = typeof(item) == 'table' and handler(item) or item
                        end

                        secondaryNumber = 1
                    end
                until secondaryNumber == 1

                number = 1
            end
        end

        return data
    end
    local function isCallbackValid(key, numberText)
        while false do end
        while false do end
        while false do end

        if isCallbackValidData[key] then
            if typeof(numberText) == 'number' then
                return numberText
            end
            if typeof(numberText) == 'string' then

                return tonumber(numberText) or numberText

        end

        return numberText
    end

    local function callback(stateData, iteratorData)
        local item = nil
        local state = nil
        local secondaryState = nil
        local alternateState = nil
        local additionalState = nil
        local fallbackState = nil
        local nestedState = nil
        local innerState = nil
        local outerState = nil

        while false do end

        local iterator, previousState, control, _ = pairs(iteratorData)

        for key, iteratorData in iterator, previousState do
            if stateData[key] ~= nil then
                if typeof(iteratorData) ~= 'table' then
                    if key ~= 'Color' or typeof(stateData[key]) ~= 'table' then
                        while false do end

                        local isCallbackValidFunction = isCallbackValid

                        item = stateData[key]
                        stateData[key] = isCallbackValidFunction(key, item, state, secondaryState, alternateState, additionalState, fallbackState, nestedState, innerState, outerState)

                        if typeof(iteratorData) ~= 'boolean' then
                            item = iteratorData

                            if typeof(stateData[key]) ~= typeof(item) then
                                stateData[key] = iteratorData
                            end
                        else
                            stateData[key] = stateData[key] == true
                        end
                    end
                elseif typeof(stateData[key]) == 'table' then
                    callback(stateData[key], iteratorData, item, state, secondaryState, alternateState, additionalState, fallbackState, nestedState)
                else
                    stateData[key] = handler(iteratorData)
                end
            else
                stateData[key] = handler(iteratorData)
            end
        end

        local secondaryIterator, currentState, secondaryControl, _ = pairs(stateData)

        for key in secondaryIterator, currentState, secondaryControl do
            if iteratorData[key] == nil and key ~= 'Color' then
                stateData[key] = nil
            end
        end
    end

            end
        until secondaryNumber == 1

    end

    function GetBomb(secondaryPlayer, secondaryArgument)
        local state = nil
        local secondaryState = nil
        local alternateState = nil
        local additionalState = nil
        local fallbackState = nil
        local nestedState = nil
        local innerState = nil
        local outerState = nil
        local number = 0

        while true do
            while false do end

            if number == 1 then
                break
            end
            if number == 0 then
                local iterator, previousState, control, _, _ = ipairs(secondaryPlayer.Character:GetChildren())

                for _, item in iterator, previousState do
                    if item:IsA('Tool', state, secondaryState, alternateState, additionalState, fallbackState, nestedState, innerState, outerState) and secondaryArgument == item.Name then
                        return item
                    end
                end

                local secondaryIterator, currentState, secondaryControl, _, _ = ipairs(secondaryPlayer.Backpack:GetChildren())

                for _, item in secondaryIterator, currentState do
                    if item:IsA('Tool', state, secondaryState, alternateState, additionalState, fallbackState, nestedState, innerState, outerState) and secondaryArgument == item.Name then
                        return item
                    end
                end

                number = 1
            end
        end

        return nil
    end

    function GetNearPlayers(secondaryPlayer, secondaryArgument)
        local playersState = nil
        local playersNumber = nil
        local secondaryCharacter = nil
        local ipairsResultNumber = nil
        local inputNumber = nil
        local humanoidRootPartNumber = nil
        local magnitude = nil
        local insert = nil
        local Position = nil
        local inputNumberData = nil
        local inputNumberState = nil
        local secondaryInputNumberState = nil
        local alternateInputNumberState = nil
        local additionalInputNumberState = nil
        local fallbackInputNumberState = nil
        local nestedInputNumberState = nil
        local innerInputNumberState = nil
        local outerInputNumberState = nil
        local previousInputNumberState = nil
        local currentInputNumberState = nil
        local nextInputNumberState = nil
        local sourceInputNumberState = nil
        local targetInputNumberState = nil
        local inputNumberStateVariantA = nil
        local inputNumberStateVariantB = nil
        local state = nil
        local secondaryState = nil
        local alternateState = nil
        local additionalState = nil
        local number = 0
        local players = nil
        local position = nil
        local humanoidRootPartContainer = nil
        local HumanoidRootPart = nil
        local states = nil

        repeat
            local secondaryNumber = 0

            repeat
                if secondaryNumber == 0 then
                    if number == 1 then
                        local secondaryNumber = 0

                        while secondaryNumber ~= 1 do
                            if secondaryNumber == 0 then
                                if not humanoidRootPartContainer then
                                    return position
                                end

                                HumanoidRootPart = humanoidRootPartContainer:FindFirstChild('HumanoidRootPart', playersState, playersNumber, secondaryCharacter, ipairsResultNumber, inputNumber, humanoidRootPartNumber, magnitude, insert, Position)
                                secondaryNumber = 1
                            end
                        end

                        if not HumanoidRootPart then
                            return position
                        end

                        number = 2
                    end
                    if number == 0 then
                        local secondaryNumber = 0

                        while secondaryNumber ~= 1 do
                            if secondaryNumber == 0 then
                                players = game:GetService('Players')
                                position = {}
                                secondaryNumber = 1
                            end
                        end

                        humanoidRootPartContainer = secondaryPlayer.Character
                        number = 1
                    end

                    secondaryNumber = 1
                end
            until secondaryNumber == 1

            if number == 2 then
                local ipairsResult, secondaryIpairsResult, alternateIpairsResult, additionalIpairsResult, fallbackIpairsResult

                ipairsResult, secondaryIpairsResult, alternateIpairsResult, additionalIpairsResult, fallbackIpairsResult, playersNumber, secondaryCharacter, ipairsResultNumber, inputNumber, humanoidRootPartNumber = ipairs(players:GetPlayers())

                for key, item in ipairsResult, secondaryIpairsResult do
                    if item ~= secondaryPlayer then
                        playersNumber = 0

                        while playersNumber ~= 0 do end

                        secondaryCharacter = item.Character

                        if secondaryCharacter then
                            ipairsResultNumber = 0

                            while ipairsResultNumber ~= 0 do end

                            magnitude = secondaryCharacter
                            insert = 'HumanoidRootPart'
                            humanoidRootPartNumber = secondaryCharacter.FindFirstChild(magnitude, insert, Position, inputNumberData, inputNumberState, secondaryInputNumberState, alternateInputNumberState, additionalInputNumberState, fallbackInputNumberState, nestedInputNumberState, innerInputNumberState, outerInputNumberState, previousInputNumberState, currentInputNumberState, nextInputNumberState, sourceInputNumberState, targetInputNumberState, inputNumberStateVariantA, inputNumberStateVariantB)
                            inputNumber = humanoidRootPartNumber

                            if inputNumber then
                                humanoidRootPartNumber = 0

                                while humanoidRootPartNumber ~= 0 do end

                                local HumanoidRootPartPosition = HumanoidRootPart.Position

                                Position = inputNumber.Position
                                insert = HumanoidRootPartPosition - Position
                                magnitude = insert.Magnitude

                                if magnitude <= secondaryArgument then
                                    insert = table.insert
                                    Position = position
                                    inputNumberData = {
                                        Player = item,
                                        Distance = magnitude,
                                    }

                                    insert(Position, inputNumberData, inputNumberState, secondaryInputNumberState, alternateInputNumberState, additionalInputNumberState, fallbackInputNumberState, nestedInputNumberState, innerInputNumberState, outerInputNumberState, previousInputNumberState, currentInputNumberState, nextInputNumberState, sourceInputNumberState, targetInputNumberState, inputNumberStateVariantA, inputNumberStateVariantB, state, secondaryState, alternateState, additionalState)
                                end
                            end
                        end
                    end
                end

                table.sort(position, function(distanceArgument, secondaryArgument)
                    return distanceArgument.Distance < secondaryArgument.Distance
                end, v367, v368, playersNumber, secondaryCharacter, ipairsResultNumber, inputNumber, humanoidRootPartNumber, magnitude)

                states = {}
                number = 3
                playersState = v368
            end
        until number == 3

        while false do end

        local iterator, fallbackState, control, _, _, _, _, _, ipairsResult, secondaryIpairsResult, alternateIpairsResult = ipairs(position)

        for _, item in iterator, fallbackState do
            table.insert(states, item.Player, ipairsResult, secondaryIpairsResult, alternateIpairsResult, Position, inputNumberData, inputNumberState, secondaryInputNumberState, alternateInputNumberState, additionalInputNumberState, fallbackInputNumberState, nestedInputNumberState, innerInputNumberState, outerInputNumberState, previousInputNumberState)
        end

        return states
    end

    local function concat(matchState)

        local secondaryConcatState = nil
        local alternateConcatState = nil
        local additionalConcatState = nil
        local fallbackConcatState = nil
        local nestedConcatState = nil
        local innerConcatState = nil
        local outerConcatState = nil
        local previousConcatState = nil
        local currentConcatState = nil
        local nextConcatState = nil
        local concatNumber = 0
        local number = nil
        local concatCondition = nil

        repeat
            if concatNumber == 0 then
                number = 0
                concatCondition = nil
                concatNumber = 1
            end
        until concatNumber == 1

        local gmatchData = nil

        repeat
            local concatNumber = 0

            while concatNumber ~= 1 do
                if concatNumber == 0 then
                    if number == 0 then
                        local concatNumber = 0

                        while concatNumber ~= 1 do
                            if concatNumber == 0 then
                                gmatch = matchState
                                concatText = '[\216-\219][\128-\191]'
                                concatCondition = matchState.match(gmatch, concatText, insert, textData, text, key, secondaryConcatText, concatState)
                                gmatchData = {}
                                concatNumber = 1
                            end
                        end

                        number = 1
                    end
                    if number == 1 then
                        local secondaryGmatch, alternateGmatch, additionalGmatch

                        secondaryGmatch, alternateGmatch, gmatch, additionalGmatch, insert, textData, text = matchState:gmatch('[%z\1-\127\194-\244][\128-\191]*', concatText, insert, textData, text, key)

                        for concatText in secondaryGmatch, alternateGmatch, gmatch do
                            if concatText == ' ' then
                                insert = table.insert
                                textData = gmatchData
                                text = '  '

                                insert(textData, text, key, secondaryConcatText, concatState, secondaryConcatState, alternateConcatState, additionalConcatState, fallbackConcatState, nestedConcatState, innerConcatState)
                            else
                                insert = table.insert
                                textData = gmatchData
                                key = concatText
                                secondaryConcatText = '\u{bb}'
                                text = '\u{ab}' .. key .. secondaryConcatText

                                insert(textData, text, key, secondaryConcatText, concatState, secondaryConcatState, alternateConcatState, additionalConcatState, fallbackConcatState, nestedConcatState, innerConcatState)
                            end
                        end

                        if concatCondition then
                            local concatNumber = 0
                            local concatData = nil

                            repeat
                                if concatNumber == 0 then
                                    concatData = {}
                                    insert = -1

                                    for index = #gmatchData, 1, insert do
                                        text = table.insert
                                        key = concatData
                                        secondaryConcatText = gmatchData[index]

                                        text(key, secondaryConcatText, concatState, secondaryConcatState, alternateConcatState, additionalConcatState, fallbackConcatState, nestedConcatState, innerConcatState, outerConcatState, previousConcatState, currentConcatState, nextConcatState)
                                    end

                                    concatNumber = 1
                                    textData = i3
                                end
                            until concatNumber == 1

                            return table.concat(concatData, insert, textData, text, key, secondaryConcatText, concatState, secondaryConcatState)
                        end

                        number = 2
                        concatText = v411
                    end

                    concatNumber = 1
                end
            end
        until number == 2

        return table.concat(gmatchData, gmatch, concatText, insert, textData, text)
    end

    function SetOnline()
        pcall(function()
            local httpServiceState = nil
            local valueType = nil
            local valueTypeState = nil
            local secondaryValueTypeState = nil
            local alternateValueTypeState = nil
            local additionalValueTypeState = nil
            local fallbackValueTypeState = nil
            local nestedValueTypeState = nil
            local flag = nil

            while false do end

            local number = 0

            repeat
                if number == 0 then
                    getgenv().online = nil

                    local pairsFunction = pairs
                    local httpService = game:GetService('HttpService')
                    local JSONDecode = httpService.JSONDecode
                    local requestFunction = request
                    local counter = {
                        Url = 'https://counter-7sone.onrender.com/counter',
                        Method = 'GET',
                    }

                    for _, item in pairsFunction(JSONDecode(httpService, requestFunction(counter).Body, counter, valueType))do
                        repeat
                            if flag or type(item) == 'number' then
                                flag = false
                                valueType = getgenv()
                                valueType.online = tostring(item)
                            else
                                valueType = type(item)

                                if valueType == 'string' then
                                    valueType = item:match('%d', valueTypeState, secondaryValueTypeState, alternateValueTypeState, additionalValueTypeState, fallbackValueTypeState, nestedValueTypeState)

                                    if valueType then
                                        flag = true
                                    end
                                end
                            end
                        until not flag
                    end

                    number = 1
                    httpServiceState = v3547
                end
            until number == 1

            getgenv().VR7.Background.Home_Section.Announce_Label_Frame.Title2.Text = tostring(utf8.char(128994) .. ' ' .. getgenv().online)
        end)
    end

    function RandomChar()
        local charResult = nil
        local random = nil
        local randomResultState = nil
        local secondaryRandomResultState = nil
        local charResultState = nil
        local secondaryCharResultState = nil
        local alternateCharResultState = nil
        local additionalCharResultState = nil
        local fallbackCharResultState = nil
        local nestedCharResultState = nil
        local innerCharResultState = nil
        local outerCharResultState = nil
        local previousCharResultState = nil
        local number = 0
        local secondaryNumber = nil
        local randomResult = nil

        repeat
            if number == 0 then
                secondaryNumber = 0
                randomResult = nil
                number = 1
            end
        until number == 1

        local data = nil

        repeat
            while false do end

            if secondaryNumber == 0 then
                local number = 0

                while number ~= 1 do
                    if number == 0 then
                        randomResult = math.random(1, 5)
                        data = {}
                        number = 1
                    end
                end

                secondaryNumber = 1
            end
        until secondaryNumber == 1

        local alternateNumber = 1

        for index = 1, randomResult, alternateNumber do
            local char = string.char

            random = math.random
            charResult = char(random(32, 126, charResultState, secondaryCharResultState, alternateCharResultState, additionalCharResultState, fallbackCharResultState, nestedCharResultState, innerCharResultState, outerCharResultState, previousCharResultState))
            data[index] = charResult
        end

        return table.concat(data, alternateNumber, i4, charResult, random)
    end
    function IsAnimationPlaying(displayValue)
        local optionState = nil
        local secondaryOptionState = nil
        local alternateOptionState = nil
        local additionalOptionState = nil
        local number = 0
        local iteratorOption = nil

        repeat
            while false do end

            if number == 0 then
                local secondaryNumber = 0

                while secondaryNumber ~= 1 do
                    if secondaryNumber == 0 then
                        iteratorOption = game.Players.LocalPlayer.Character and game.Players.LocalPlayer.Character:FindFirstChildOfClass('Humanoid', optionState, secondaryOptionState, alternateOptionState, additionalOptionState)

                        if not iteratorOption then
                            return false
                        end

                        secondaryNumber = 1
                    end
                end

                number = 1
            end
        until number == 1

        while false do end

        local iterator, state, control, _, _, _ = pairs(iteratorOption:GetPlayingAnimationTracks())

        for _, item in iterator, state do
            if item.Animation.AnimationId == 'rbxassetid://' .. tostring(displayValue) then
                return true
            end
        end

        return false
    end

            if game.Players.LocalPlayer.Character:FindFirstChildWhichIsA('Humanoid') and HumanoidRootPart and HumanoidRootPart:FindFirstChild(name) and HumanoidRootPart:FindFirstChild(createSiudnajText) then
                local createSiudnajNumber = 0
                local firstChild = nil
                local secondaryFirstChild = nil
                local MoveVector = nil

                while true do
                    if createSiudnajNumber == 2 then
                        firstChild.Velocity = velocity
                        MoveVector = ControlModule:GetMoveVector()

                        if MoveVector.X ~= 0 then
                            firstChild.Velocity = firstChild.Velocity + currentCamera.CFrame.RightVector * MoveVector.X * f * 50
                        end

                        createSiudnajNumber = 3
                    end
                    if createSiudnajNumber == 0 then
                        game.Players.LocalPlayer.Character:FindFirstChildWhichIsA('Humanoid', LookVector, createSiudnajState, secondaryCreateSiudnajState, alternateCreateSiudnajState, additionalCreateSiudnajState)

                        firstChild = HumanoidRootPart:FindFirstChild(name, LookVector, createSiudnajState, secondaryCreateSiudnajState, alternateCreateSiudnajState, additionalCreateSiudnajState)
                        secondaryFirstChild = HumanoidRootPart:FindFirstChild(createSiudnajText, LookVector, createSiudnajState, secondaryCreateSiudnajState, alternateCreateSiudnajState, additionalCreateSiudnajState)
                        createSiudnajNumber = 1
                    end
                    if createSiudnajNumber == 3 then
                        break
                    end
                    if createSiudnajNumber == 1 then
                        firstChild.MaxForce = maxTorque
                        secondaryFirstChild.MaxTorque = maxTorque

                        local new = CFrame.new
                        local HumanoidRootPartPosition = HumanoidRootPart.Position
                        local position = HumanoidRootPart.Position

                        LookVector = currentCamera.CFrame.LookVector
                        secondaryFirstChild.CFrame = new(HumanoidRootPartPosition, position + LookVector, LookVector, createSiudnajState, secondaryCreateSiudnajState, alternateCreateSiudnajState, additionalCreateSiudnajState)
                        createSiudnajNumber = 2
                    end
                end

                if MoveVector.Z ~= 0 then
                    firstChild.Velocity = firstChild.Velocity - currentCamera.CFrame.LookVector * MoveVector.Z * f * 50
                end
                if not IsAnimationPlaying(10714347256) then
                    PlayAnim(10714347256, 4, 0, createSiudnajState, secondaryCreateSiudnajState, alternateCreateSiudnajState, additionalCreateSiudnajState, fallbackCreateSiudnajState)
                end
            end
        end, fallbackCreateSiudnajState, nestedCreateSiudnajState, innerCreateSiudnajState, outerCreateSiudnajState, previousCreateSiudnajState, currentCreateSiudnajState, nextCreateSiudnajState)
    end

    function GetSofa()
        local state = nil
        local secondaryState = nil
        local alternateState = nil
        local additionalState = nil
        local fallbackState = nil
        local nestedState = nil
        local innerState = nil

        while false do end

        local number = 0

        repeat
            while false do end

            if number == 0 then
                local iterator, outerState, control, _ = ipairs(game.Players.LocalPlayer.Backpack:GetChildren())

                for _, item in iterator, outerState do
                    if item:IsA('Tool', state, secondaryState, alternateState, additionalState, fallbackState, nestedState, innerState) and item.Name == 'Couch' then
                        while false do end

                        item.Parent = game.Players.LocalPlayer.Character

                        return item
                    end
                end

                local secondaryIterator, previousState, secondaryControl, _ = ipairs(game.Players.LocalPlayer.Character:GetChildren())

                for _, item in secondaryIterator, previousState do
                    if item:IsA('Tool', state, secondaryState, alternateState, additionalState, fallbackState, nestedState, innerState) and item.Name == 'Couch' then
                        return item
                    end
                end

                number = 1
            end
        until number == 1

        return nil
    end
    function BrookBring(argument, flag)
        local platformState = nil
        local secondaryPlatformState = nil
        local sizeNumber = nil
        local sizeState = nil
        local secondarySizeState = nil
        local cFrame = nil
        local text = nil
        local unitNumber = nil
        local sumNumber = nil
        local sumState = nil
        local secondarySumState = nil
        local alternateSumState = nil
        local additionalSumState = nil
        local fallbackSumState = nil
        local nestedSumState = nil
        local innerSumState = nil
        local outerSumState = nil
        local previousSumState = nil
        local currentSumState = nil
        local nextSumState = nil
        local secondaryPlayer = game.Players[argument]
        local Platform = nil

        if game.workspace:FindFirstChild('Platform', platformState, secondaryPlatformState, sizeNumber) then
            Platform = game.workspace:FindFirstChild('Platform', platformState, secondaryPlatformState, sizeNumber)
        else
            while false do end

            local number = 0

            repeat
                if number == 0 then
                    Platform = Instance.new('Part', workspace, sizeNumber, sizeState, secondarySizeState, cFrame, text)
                    Platform.Name = 'Platform'
                    number = 1
                end
                if number == 2 then
                    sizeNumber = 0
                    Platform.CFrame = CFrame.new(0, -500, sizeNumber, sizeState, secondarySizeState, cFrame, text, unitNumber)
                    Platform.CanCollide = true
                    number = 3
                end
                if number == 1 then
                    Platform.Anchored = true
                    sizeNumber = 200
                    Platform.Size = Vector3.new(200, 1, sizeNumber, sizeState, secondarySizeState, cFrame, text, unitNumber)
                    number = 2
                end
            until number == 3

            Platform.Transparency = 1
        end

        local sum = 0
        local number = 0
        local HumanoidRootPartCFrame = game.Players.LocalPlayer.Character.HumanoidRootPart.CFrame
        local secondarySum, unit

        repeat
            task.wait()

            number = number + 1

            local getSofa = GetSofa()

            if not getSofa then
                secondarySum = '\u{62a}\u{62d}\u{62a}\u{627}\u{62c} \u{643}\u{646}\u{628}\u{629} \u{62d}\u{62a}\u{627} \u{62a}\u{642}\u{62f}\u{631} \u{62a}\u{633}\u{62d}\u{628}'
                unit = 5

                SendNotify('System VR7', secondarySum, unit, cFrame, text, unitNumber, sumNumber, sumState, secondarySumState, alternateSumState)

                break
            end

            local instance = nil

            if getSofa.Seat1.Occupant ~= nil then
                if not getSofa.Seat1.Occupant or getSofa.Seat1.Occupant ~= secondaryPlayer.Character.Humanoid then
                    if getSofa.Seat1.Occupant and getSofa.Seat1.Occupant ~= secondaryPlayer.Character.Humanoid then
                        if getSofa.Seat2.Occupant ~= nil then
                            if getSofa.Seat2.Occupant and getSofa.Seat2.Occupant == secondaryPlayer.Character.Humanoid then
                                instance = getSofa.Seat2
                            end
                        else
                            instance = getSofa.Seat2
                        end
                    end
                else
                    instance = getSofa.Seat1
                end
            else
                instance = getSofa.Seat1
            end
            if secondaryPlayer.Character.Humanoid.Sit and instance == secondaryPlayer.Character.Humanoid.SeatPart then
                if not flag then
                    local HumanoidRootPart = game.Players.LocalPlayer.Character.HumanoidRootPart
                    local PlatformCFrame = Platform.CFrame

                    cFrame = 0
                    text = 5
                    unitNumber = 0
                    unit = CFrame.new(cFrame, text, unitNumber, sumNumber, sumState, secondarySumState, alternateSumState, additionalSumState, fallbackSumState, nestedSumState, innerSumState, outerSumState, previousSumState)
                    HumanoidRootPart.CFrame = PlatformCFrame * unit
                else
                    while false do end
                    while false do end

                    game.Players.LocalPlayer.Character.HumanoidRootPart.CFrame = HumanoidRootPartCFrame
                    cFrame = game.Players.LocalPlayer.Character.Humanoid
                    unit = cFrame.ChangeState
                    text = 'GettingUp'

                    unit(cFrame, text, unitNumber, sumNumber, sumState, secondarySumState, alternateSumState, additionalSumState, fallbackSumState, nestedSumState, innerSumState, outerSumState)
                end

                secondarySum = 1

                wait(secondarySum)

                getSofa.Parent = game.Players.LocalPlayer.Backpack

                break
            end
            if secondaryPlayer.Character.Humanoid.Sit and instance ~= secondaryPlayer.Character.Humanoid.SeatPart then
                secondarySum = 'System VR7'
                unit = '\u{644}\u{627}\u{64a}\u{645}\u{643}\u{646} \u{633}\u{62d}\u{628} \u{627}\u{644}\u{636}\u{62d}\u{64a}\u{629} \u{644}\u{627}\u{646}\u{647} \u{642}\u{627}\u{639}\u{62f}'
                cFrame = 5

                SendNotify(secondarySum, unit, cFrame, text, unitNumber, sumNumber, sumState, secondarySumState, alternateSumState, additionalSumState, fallbackSumState)

                break
            end
            if getSofa.Parent ~= game.Players.LocalPlayer.Character then
                getSofa.Parent = game.Players.LocalPlayer.Character
            end

            local product = math.sin(sum) * 4

            sum = sum + 0.2
            secondarySum = secondaryPlayer.Character.HumanoidRootPart.Position + Vector3.new(0, -4.5 + product, 0, sumNumber, sumState, secondarySumState, alternateSumState, additionalSumState, fallbackSumState, nestedSumState, innerSumState, outerSumState, previousSumState) + secondaryPlayer.Character.HumanoidRootPart.CFrame.lookVector * -0.7 + secondaryPlayer.Character.HumanoidRootPart.Velocity * Vector3.new(0.2, 0, 0.2, sumState, secondarySumState, alternateSumState, additionalSumState, fallbackSumState, nestedSumState, innerSumState, outerSumState, previousSumState, currentSumState, nextSumState)
            sumNumber = 1
            unit = (secondaryPlayer.Character.HumanoidRootPart.CFrame.lookVector * Vector3.new(1, 0, sumNumber, sumState, secondarySumState, alternateSumState, additionalSumState, fallbackSumState, nestedSumState, innerSumState, outerSumState, previousSumState, currentSumState, nextSumState)).Unit

            local new = CFrame.new

            text = secondarySum
            unitNumber = secondarySum - unit
            cFrame = new(text, unitNumber, sumNumber, sumState, secondarySumState, alternateSumState, additionalSumState, fallbackSumState, nestedSumState, innerSumState, outerSumState, previousSumState, currentSumState)
            instance.CFrame = cFrame
        until number >= 200

        game.Players.LocalPlayer.Character.HumanoidRootPart.CFrame = HumanoidRootPartCFrame

        game.Players.LocalPlayer.Character.Humanoid:ChangeState('GettingUp', secondarySum, unit, cFrame, text, unitNumber, sumNumber)
    end

    function GetPlayer(argument)
        local matchState = nil
        local secondaryMatchState = nil
        local localValuePlayer = nil
        local matchNumber = nil
        local alternateMatchState = nil
        local additionalMatchState = nil
        local fallbackMatchState = nil
        local nestedMatchState = nil
        local innerMatchState = nil
        local outerMatchState = nil
        local previousMatchState = nil
        local currentMatchState = nil
        local nextMatchState = nil
        local sourceMatchState = nil
        local targetMatchState = nil
        local matchStateVariantA = nil
        local matchStateVariantB = nil
        local matchStateVariantC = nil

        if argument == '' then
            return nil
        end

        local number = 0

        repeat
            while false do end

            if number == 0 then
                local secondaryNumber = 0

                while secondaryNumber ~= 1 do
                    if secondaryNumber == 0 then
                        local match = argument:match('^%s*(.-)%s*$', matchState, secondaryMatchState, localValuePlayer, matchNumber)
                        local ipairsResult, secondaryIpairsResult, alternateIpairsResult, additionalIpairsResult, fallbackIpairsResult

                        ipairsResult, secondaryIpairsResult, alternateIpairsResult, additionalIpairsResult, fallbackIpairsResult, localValuePlayer = ipairs(game.Players:GetPlayers())

                        for key, item in ipairsResult, secondaryIpairsResult do
                            localValuePlayer = game.Players.LocalPlayer

                            if item ~= localValuePlayer then
                                localValuePlayer = 0
                                matchNumber = nil

                                local secondaryMatch = nil

                                repeat
                                    if localValuePlayer == 0 then
                                        matchNumber = 0
                                        secondaryMatch = nil
                                        localValuePlayer = 1
                                    end
                                until localValuePlayer == 1

                                local alternateMatch = nil

                                while matchNumber ~= 1 do
                                    if matchNumber == 0 then
                                        local number = 0

                                        while number ~= 1 do
                                            if number == 0 then
                                                secondaryMatch = item.Name:lower():match('^%s*(.-)%s*$', alternateMatchState, additionalMatchState, fallbackMatchState, nestedMatchState, innerMatchState, outerMatchState, previousMatchState, currentMatchState, nextMatchState, sourceMatchState, targetMatchState, matchStateVariantA, matchStateVariantB, matchStateVariantC)
                                                alternateMatch = item.DisplayName:lower():match('^%s*(.-)%s*$', alternateMatchState, additionalMatchState, fallbackMatchState, nestedMatchState, innerMatchState, outerMatchState, previousMatchState, currentMatchState, nextMatchState, sourceMatchState, targetMatchState, matchStateVariantA, matchStateVariantB, matchStateVariantC)
                                                number = 1
                                            end
                                        end

                                        matchNumber = 1
                                    end
                                end

                                if secondaryMatch:sub(1, #match, alternateMatchState) == match:lower() or alternateMatch:sub(1, #match, alternateMatchState) == match:lower() then
                                    return item
                                end
                            end
                        end

                        secondaryNumber = 1
                        matchState = v614
                        secondaryMatchState = v615
                    end
                end

                number = 1
            end
        until number == 1

        return nil
    end
    function GetPlayerV1(argument)
        local matchState = nil
        local secondaryMatchState = nil
        local match = nil
        local subState = nil
        local lowercaseText = nil
        local lowerState = nil
        local alternateMatchState = nil
        local additionalMatchState = nil
        local fallbackMatchState = nil
        local nestedMatchState = nil
        local innerMatchState = nil
        local outerMatchState = nil
        local previousMatchState = nil
        local currentMatchState = nil
        local nextMatchState = nil
        local subResultState = nil
        local secondarySubResultState = nil
        local alternateSubResultState = nil

        if argument == '' then
            return nil
        end

        local number = 0

        while true do
            while false do end

            if number == 1 then
                break
            end
            if number == 0 then
                local secondaryNumber = 0

                while secondaryNumber ~= 1 do
                    if secondaryNumber == 0 then
                        local secondaryMatch = argument:match('^%s*(.-)%s*$', matchState, secondaryMatchState, match, subState)
                        local ipairsResult, secondaryIpairsResult, alternateIpairsResult, additionalIpairsResult, fallbackIpairsResult

                        ipairsResult, secondaryIpairsResult, alternateIpairsResult, additionalIpairsResult, fallbackIpairsResult, match = ipairs(game.Players:GetPlayers())

                        for key, item in ipairsResult, secondaryIpairsResult do
                            match = item.Name:lower():match('^%s*(.-)%s*$', lowercaseText, lowerState, alternateMatchState, additionalMatchState, fallbackMatchState, nestedMatchState, innerMatchState, outerMatchState, previousMatchState)
                            subState = item.DisplayName:lower():match('^%s*(.-)%s*$', lowerState, alternateMatchState, additionalMatchState, fallbackMatchState, nestedMatchState, innerMatchState, outerMatchState, previousMatchState, currentMatchState, nextMatchState)

                            if match:sub(1, #secondaryMatch, additionalMatchState) == secondaryMatch:lower() then
                                return item
                            end

                            local sub = subState.sub

                            alternateMatchState = #secondaryMatch

                            local subResult = sub(subState, 1, alternateMatchState, additionalMatchState, fallbackMatchState, nestedMatchState, innerMatchState, outerMatchState, previousMatchState, currentMatchState, nextMatchState, subResultState, secondarySubResultState, alternateSubResultState)

                            lowerState = secondaryMatch
                            lowercaseText = secondaryMatch.lower(lowerState)

                            if subResult == lowercaseText then
                                return item
                            end
                        end

                        secondaryNumber = 1
                        matchState = v646
                        secondaryMatchState = v647
                    end
                end

                number = 1
            end
        end

        return nil
    end
    function GetPlayerV2(argument)
        local matchState = nil
        local secondaryMatchState = nil
        local alternateMatchState = nil
        local state = nil
        local number = 0
        local match = nil

        repeat
            if number == 0 then
                if argument == '' then
                    return nil
                end

                match = argument:lower():match('^%s*(.-)%s*$', matchState, secondaryMatchState, alternateMatchState)
                number = 1
            end
            if number == 1 then
                local localValuePlayer = game.Players.LocalPlayer

                if match == localValuePlayer.Name:lower():sub(1, #match, secondaryMatchState, alternateMatchState, state) then
                    return localValuePlayer
                end

                local lower = localValuePlayer.DisplayName:lower()
                local sub = lower.sub

                matchState = #match

                if match == sub(lower, 1, matchState, secondaryMatchState, alternateMatchState, state) then
                    return localValuePlayer
                end

                number = 2
            end
        until number == 2

        return nil
    end

                    GetRoot(LocalPlayer).CFrame = CFrame.new(GetRoot(quaternaryArgument).Position) + Vector3.new(0, 2, 0, secondaryCFrameState, alternateCFrameState, additionalCFrameState)

                    local secondaryCFrameState = nil
                    local alternateCFrameState = nil
                    local additionalCFrameState = nil
                    local fallbackCFrameState = nil

                                task.wait()

                        else
                            GetRoot(LocalPlayer).CFrame = CFrame.new(argument, secondaryArgument, tertiaryArgument, cFrameNumber, cFrameState, secondaryCFrameState, alternateCFrameState, additionalCFrameState)
                        end
                    end
                end)

        end)
    end

                            number = 1
                        end
                    until number == 1

                    local secondaryInput = inputOption and inputOption.RootPart

                    if secondaryInput and (RootPart.Position - secondaryInput.Position).Magnitude < 2 then
                        while false do end
                        while false do end

                        local secondaryNext = next
                        local playingAnimationTracks, secondaryPlayingAnimationTracks, _, _, _, _, _, alternatePlayingAnimationTracks, additionalPlayingAnimationTracks, fallbackPlayingAnimationTracks, nestedPlayingAnimationTracks, innerPlayingAnimationTracks, outerPlayingAnimationTracks, previousPlayingAnimationTracks, currentPlayingAnimationTracks = inputOption:GetPlayingAnimationTracks()

    function Cuffbring()
        local state = nil
        local secondaryState = nil
        local onPlayerAddedFunction = nil
        local playerAdded = nil
        local ipairsResult = nil
        local connectionState = nil
        local alternateState = nil
        local additionalState = nil
        local fallbackState = nil
        local nestedState = nil
        local innerState = nil
        local outerState = nil
        local previousState = nil
        local currentState = nil
        local nextState = nil
        local sourceState = nil
        local targetState = nil
        local stateVariantA = nil

        if getgenv().Cuff.Bring then
            local number = 0
            local getCuff = nil
            local data = nil
            local states = nil
            local onPlayerAdded = nil
            local secondaryConnection = nil

            repeat
                if number == 1 then
                    local secondaryNumber = 0

                    repeat
                        if secondaryNumber == 0 then
                            states = {}
                            secondaryNumber = 1
                        end
                    until secondaryNumber == 1

                    function onPlayerAdded(playerAdded)
                        local connectionState = nil
                        local secondaryConnectionState = nil

                        local function onCharacterAdded(characterAdded)
                            local humanoidState = nil
                            local secondaryHumanoidState = nil
                            local connectionState = nil
                            local secondaryConnectionState = nil
                            local alternateConnectionState = nil
                            local additionalConnectionState = nil

                            while false do end

                            local humanoid = characterAdded:FindFirstChildOfClass('Humanoid', humanoidState, secondaryHumanoidState)

                            if humanoid then
                                while false do end

                                local secondaryConnection = humanoid.Died:Connect(function()
                                    data[playerAdded] = os.time()
                                end, connectionState, secondaryConnectionState, alternateConnectionState, additionalConnectionState)

                                table.insert(states, secondaryConnection, connectionState, secondaryConnectionState, alternateConnectionState, additionalConnectionState)
                            end
                        end

                        if playerAdded.Character then
                            onCharacterAdded(playerAdded.Character)
                        end

                        local secondaryConnection = playerAdded.CharacterAdded:Connect(onCharacterAdded, connectionState, secondaryConnectionState)

                        table.insert(states, secondaryConnection, connectionState, secondaryConnectionState)
                    end

                    number = 2
                end
                if number == 2 then
                    local secondaryNumber = 0

                    repeat
                        if secondaryNumber == 0 then
                            local secondaryIpairsResult, alternateIpairsResult, additionalIpairsResult, fallbackIpairsResult, nestedIpairsResult

                            secondaryIpairsResult, alternateIpairsResult, additionalIpairsResult, fallbackIpairsResult, nestedIpairsResult, onPlayerAddedFunction, playerAdded, ipairsResult = ipairs(game.Players:GetPlayers())

                            for key, item in secondaryIpairsResult, alternateIpairsResult do
                                onPlayerAddedFunction = onPlayerAdded
                                playerAdded = item

                                onPlayerAddedFunction(playerAdded)
                            end

                            secondaryConnection = game.Players.PlayerAdded:Connect(onPlayerAdded, v786, v787, onPlayerAddedFunction, playerAdded, ipairsResult, connectionState)
                            secondaryNumber = 1
                            state = v786
                            secondaryState = v787
                        end
                    until secondaryNumber == 1

                    table.insert(states, secondaryConnection, state, secondaryState, onPlayerAddedFunction, playerAdded, ipairsResult, connectionState)

                    number = 3
                end
                if number == 0 then
                    local secondaryNumber = 0

                    while secondaryNumber ~= 1 do
                        if secondaryNumber == 0 then
                            getCuff = GetCuff()

                            if not getCuff then
                                while false do end
                                while false do end
                                while false do end

                                game:GetService('StarterGui'):SetCore('SendNotification', {
                                    Title = 'System VR7',
                                    Text = '\u{644}\u{627}\u{632}\u{645} \u{64a}\u{643}\u{648}\u{646} \u{645}\u{639}\u{643} \u{643}\u{644}\u{628}\u{634}\u{629}',
                                    Duration = 5,
                                }, ipairsResult, connectionState, alternateState, additionalState, fallbackState, nestedState, innerState, outerState, previousState)

                                return
                            end

                            secondaryNumber = 1
                        end
                    end

                    data = {}
                    number = 1
                end
            until number == 3

            task.spawn(function()
                if getgenv().Cuff.Throw then
                    local number = 0
                    local HumanoidRootPartCFrame = nil

                    while number ~= 1 do
                        if number == 0 then
                            HumanoidRootPartCFrame = game.Players.LocalPlayer.Character.HumanoidRootPart.CFrame

                            while getgenv().Cuff.Throw do
                                while false do end
                                while false do end

                                pcall(function()
                                    local cFrameNumber = nil

                                        if number == 0 then

                                            game.Players.LocalPlayer.Character.HumanoidRootPart.AssemblyLinearVelocity = Vector3.new()
                                            number = 1
                                            cFrameNumber = cFrameStateNumber
                                        end
                                    end

                                    game.Players.LocalPlayer.Character.Humanoid.Sit = true
                                end)
                            end

                            number = 1
                        end
                    end

                    pcall(function()
                        while false do end

                        game.Players.LocalPlayer.Character.HumanoidRootPart.CFrame = HumanoidRootPartCFrame
                        game.Players.LocalPlayer.Character.Humanoid.Sit = false
                    end)
                end
            end)

            while getgenv().Cuff.Bring do
                while false do end
                while false do end

                wait()

                local iterator, state, control, _, _, _, _, _, ipairsResult = ipairs(game.Players:GetPlayers())

                for _, item in iterator, state do
                    if not getgenv().Cuff.Bring then
                        break
                    end
                    if item ~= game.Players.LocalPlayer and item.Character and not item.Character:FindFirstChild('ForceField', ipairsResult, additionalState, fallbackState, nestedState, innerState, outerState, previousState, currentState, nextState, sourceState, targetState, stateVariantA) and (not data[item] or os.time() - data[item] > 8) then

                                        getCuff.Parent = game.Players.LocalPlayer.Character
                                    end

                                    number = 1
                                end
                            until number == 1

                            task.wait(1.5)
                        end)
                    end
                end
            end

            local iterator, stateVariantB, control, _, _, _, _ = ipairs(states)

            for _, item in iterator, stateVariantB do

                    item:Disconnect()
                end
            end
        end

    function WhatTime()
        while false do end

        if not (os.date('*t').hour < 12) then
            return 'dark'
        end

        return 'light'
    end
    function PlayAnim(text, timePosition, tertiaryArgument, secondaryFlag)
        local number = 0
        local flag = nil

        repeat
            if number == 0 then
                local secondaryNumber = 0

                while secondaryNumber ~= 1 do
                    if secondaryNumber == 0 then
                        flag = secondaryFlag

                        if game.PlaceId == 11379739543 then
                            return
                        end

                        secondaryNumber = 1
                    end
                end

                number = 1
            end
        until number == 1

        pcall(function()
            local trackState = nil
            local secondaryTrackState = nil
            local stop = nil
            local item = nil
            local alternateTrackState = nil
            local number = 0
            local secondaryNumber = nil
            local humanoid = nil
            local playingAnimationTracks = nil
            local animation = nil

            repeat
                if number == 0 then
                    secondaryNumber = 0
                    humanoid = nil
                    number = 1
                end
                if number == 1 then
                    playingAnimationTracks = nil
                    animation = nil
                    number = 2
                end
            until number == 2

            local track = nil

            while true do
                if secondaryNumber == 1 then
                    LocalPlayer.Character.Animate.Disabled = true
                    animation = Instance.new('Animation')
                    animation.AnimationId = 'rbxassetid://' .. text
                    track = humanoid:LoadAnimation(animation, trackState, secondaryTrackState, stop, item, alternateTrackState)
                    secondaryNumber = 2
                end
                if secondaryNumber == 2 then
                    break
                end
                if secondaryNumber == 0 then
                    if not flag then
                        LocalPlayer.Character.Animate.Disabled = false
                    end

                    humanoid = LocalPlayer.Character.Humanoid
                    playingAnimationTracks = humanoid:GetPlayingAnimationTracks()

                    local pairsResult, secondaryPairsResult, alternatePairsResult, additionalPairsResult, fallbackPairsResult

                    pairsResult, secondaryPairsResult, alternatePairsResult, additionalPairsResult, fallbackPairsResult, stop, item = pairs(playingAnimationTracks)

                    for key, secondaryItem in pairsResult, secondaryPairsResult do
                        item = secondaryItem
                        stop = secondaryItem.Stop

                        stop(item)
                    end

                    secondaryNumber = 1
                    trackState = v3617
                    secondaryTrackState = v3618
                end
            end

            track:Play()

            track.TimePosition = timePosition

            track:AdjustSpeed(tertiaryArgument, trackState, secondaryTrackState, stop, item, alternateTrackState)
            track.Stopped:Connect(function()
                while false do end

                local number = 0

                repeat
                    if number == 0 then
                        LocalPlayer.Character.Animate.Disabled = false

                        for _, item in pairs(playingAnimationTracks)do
                            item:Stop()
                        end

                        number = 1
                    end
                until number == 1

                animation:Destroy()
            end, trackState, secondaryTrackState, stop, item, alternateTrackState)
        end)
    end
    function StopAnim()
        local number = 0
        local PlayingAnimationTracks = nil

        while number ~= 1 do
            if number == 0 then
                game.Players.LocalPlayer.Character.Animate.Disabled = false
                PlayingAnimationTracks = game.Players.LocalPlayer.Character.Humanoid:GetPlayingAnimationTracks()
                number = 1
            end
        end

        for _, item in pairs(PlayingAnimationTracks)do
            item:Stop()
        end

        wait(0.1)
    end
    function CheckAnim(animName)
        local numberTextState = nil
        local secondaryNumberTextState = nil
        local alternateNumberTextState = nil
        local additionalNumberTextState = nil
        local fallbackNumberTextState = nil
        local nestedNumberTextState = nil
        local innerNumberTextState = nil
        local outerNumberTextState = nil
        local previousNumberTextState = nil
        local currentNumberTextState = nil
        local nextNumberTextState = nil
        local number = 0

        while true do
            while false do end

            if number == 1 then
                break
            end
            if number == 0 then
                local secondaryNumber = 0

                while secondaryNumber ~= 1 do
                    if secondaryNumber == 0 then
                        local PlayingAnimationTracks = LocalPlayer.Character.Humanoid:GetPlayingAnimationTracks()
                        local iterator, state, control, _, _, _ = pairs(PlayingAnimationTracks)

                        for _, item in iterator, state do
                            while false do end

                            local numberText = item.Animation.AnimationId:match('%d+', numberTextState, secondaryNumberTextState, alternateNumberTextState, additionalNumberTextState, fallbackNumberTextState, nestedNumberTextState, innerNumberTextState, outerNumberTextState, previousNumberTextState, currentNumberTextState, nextNumberTextState)

                            if tonumber(numberText) == tonumber(animName) then
                                return true
                            end
                        end

                        secondaryNumber = 1
                    end
                end

                number = 1
            end
        end

        return false
    end

    function GetLocalAsset(url, displayValue)
        local number = 0
        local text = nil
        local flag = nil
        local capturedResult = nil
        local pcallResult = nil
        local secondaryGetcustomasset = nil

        while true do
            if number == 3 then
                if not pcall(function()
                    secondaryGetcustomasset = getcustomasset(text)
                end) then
                    while false do end
                    while false do end

                    warn('Failed to create custom asset.')

                    return nil
                end

                number = 4
            end
            if number == 1 then
                if not flag or not capturedResult or capturedResult.StatusCode ~= 200 then
                    while false do end
                    while false do end

                    warn('Failed to download image.')

                    return nil
                end

                pcallResult = pcall(function()
                    local writefileFunction = writefile
                    local secondaryText = text
                    local _ = capturedResult.Body

                    writefileFunction(secondaryText)
                end)
                number = 2
            end
            if number == 2 then
                if not pcallResult then
                    while false do end
                    while false do end
                    while false do end

                    warn('Failed to write image.')

                    return nil
                end

                secondaryGetcustomasset = nil
                number = 3
            end
            if number == 4 then
                return secondaryGetcustomasset
            end
            if number == 0 then
                text = 'DevImage_' .. tostring(displayValue) .. '.png'

                local result, pcallResult, secondaryPcallResult, alternatePcallResult, additionalPcallResult, fallbackPcallResult, nestedPcallResult, innerPcallResult

                flag, result, pcallResult, secondaryPcallResult, alternatePcallResult, additionalPcallResult, fallbackPcallResult, nestedPcallResult, innerPcallResult = pcall(function()
                    local requestFunction = request
                    local _ = {
                        Url = url,
                        Method = 'GET',
                    }

                    return requestFunction()
                end)
                capturedResult = result
                number = 1
            end
        end
    end

    function CreateButton(name, text, parent, quaternaryArgument)
        local sizeNumber = nil
        local sizeState = nil
        local secondarySizeState = nil
        local alternateSizeState = nil
        local additionalSizeState = nil
        local fallbackSizeState = nil
        local nestedSizeState = nil
        local innerSizeState = nil
        local number = 0
        local textButton = nil

        while true do
            local secondaryNumber = 0

            while true do
                if secondaryNumber == 1 then
                    if number == 4 then
                        local number = 0

                        repeat
                            if number == 0 then
                                getgenv()[name] = textButton

                                if quaternaryArgument ~= nil then
                                    if quaternaryArgument == true then
                                        CreateToggle(textButton)
                                    end
                                else
                                    CreateClicker(textButton)
                                end

                                number = 1
                            end
                        until number == 1

                        return textButton
                    end
                    if number == 2 then
                        local secondaryNumber = 0

                        repeat
                            if secondaryNumber == 0 then
                                textButton.BorderSizePixel = 0
                                textButton.TextScaled = true
                                secondaryNumber = 1
                            end
                        until secondaryNumber == 1

                        textButton.TextWrapped = true
                        number = 3
                    end

                    secondaryNumber = 2
                end
                if secondaryNumber == 2 then
                    break
                end
                if secondaryNumber == 0 then
                    if number == 0 then
                        local secondaryNumber = 0

                        while secondaryNumber ~= 1 do
                            if secondaryNumber == 0 then
                                textButton = Instance.new('TextButton')
                                textButton.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(capturedR, secondaryCapturedG, b)
                                secondaryNumber = 1
                            end
                        end

                        textButton.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(0, 0, 0)
                        number = 1
                    end
                    if number == 1 then
                        local secondaryNumber = 0

                        repeat
                            if secondaryNumber == 0 then
                                textButton.Font = Enum.Font.Oswald
                                sizeNumber = 30
                                textButton.Size = UDim2.new(0, 150, 0, sizeNumber, sizeState, secondarySizeState, alternateSizeState, additionalSizeState, fallbackSizeState, nestedSizeState, innerSizeState)
                                secondaryNumber = 1
                            end
                        until secondaryNumber == 1

                        textButton.BackgroundTransparency = 0.5
                        number = 2
                    end

                    secondaryNumber = 1
                end
            end

            if number == 3 then
                local secondaryNumber = 0

                while secondaryNumber ~= 1 do
                    if secondaryNumber == 0 then
                        textButton.Name = name
                        textButton.Text = text
                        secondaryNumber = 1
                    end
                end

                textButton.Parent = parent
                number = 4
            end
        end
    end

    function ChangeSection(instance)
        local secondaryK = nil
        local sectionForName = nil
        local sectionForNameState = nil
        local secondarySectionForNameState = nil
        local alternateSectionForNameState = nil
        local additionalSectionForNameState = nil
        local fallbackSectionForNameState = nil
        local nestedSectionForNameState = nil
        local innerSectionForNameState = nil
        local number = 0

        while number ~= 1 do
            if number == 0 then
                SectionClickedName = string.split(instance.Name, '_', secondaryK)[1]

                for k, child in pairs(Frame:GetChildren())do
                    if child.Name == instance.Name then
                        child.Transparency = 0
                    else
                        child.Transparency = 0.5
                    end
                end

                number = 1
                secondaryK = k
            end
        end

        for _, child in pairs(ImageLabel:GetChildren())do
            if child:IsA('ScrollingFrame', sectionForName, sectionForNameState, secondarySectionForNameState, alternateSectionForNameState, additionalSectionForNameState, fallbackSectionForNameState) then
                while false do end

                SectionForName = string.split(child.Name, '_', sectionForNameState, secondarySectionForNameState, alternateSectionForNameState, additionalSectionForNameState, fallbackSectionForNameState, nestedSectionForNameState, innerSectionForNameState)[1]

                local find = string.find
                local sectionClickedName = SectionClickedName

                sectionForName = SectionForName

                if not find(sectionClickedName, sectionForName, sectionForNameState, secondarySectionForNameState, alternateSectionForNameState, additionalSectionForNameState, fallbackSectionForNameState, nestedSectionForNameState, innerSectionForNameState) then
                    child.Visible = false
                else
                    child.Visible = true
                end
            end
        end

        createSound(getgenv().ConfigData)
    end

    textButtonVariantD.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
        local sizeState = nil
        local secondaryChild = nil

        local secondaryNameState = nil
        local alternateNameState = nil

                    Invisible()
                end

        else
            if not getgenv().EnabledBefore then
                getgenv().EnabledBefore = true

                local localValuePlayer = game:GetService('Players').LocalPlayer

                humanoidContainer = localValuePlayer.Character or localValuePlayer.CharacterAdded:Wait()
                flag = false
                humanoidContainer.Archivable = true
                clone = humanoidContainer:Clone()

                local Part = Instance.new('Part', workspace)

                Part.Anchored = true
                Part.Size = Vector3.new(200, 1, 200, sizeState)
                Part.CFrame = CFrame.new(0, -500, 0, sizeState)
                Part.CanCollide = true
                Part.Transparency = 1
                clone.Parent = workspace

                local name = 0

                clone.HumanoidRootPart.CFrame = Part.CFrame * CFrame.new(0, 5, name, secondaryChild, parent, alternateChild)

                local alternateFlag = nil

                for _, child in pairs(humanoidContainer:GetChildren())do
                    secondaryChild = child
                    parent = 'LocalScript'
                    name = child.IsA(secondaryChild, parent, alternateChild, additionalChild, nameState, secondaryNameState, alternateNameState, additionalNameState)

                    if name then
                        name = 0
                        secondaryChild = nil

                        while name ~= 1 do
                            if name == 0 then
                                local number = 0

                                repeat
                                    if number == 0 then
                                        additionalChild = child
                                        alternateChild = child.Clone(additionalChild)
                                        secondaryChild = alternateChild
                                        secondaryChild.Disabled = true
                                        number = 1
                                    end
                                until number == 1

                                name = 1
                            end
                        end

                local function createPart()

    local function updateInstanceProperties()
        local updateInstancePropertiesNumber = nil
        local number = nil
        local secondaryInstancePropertiesNumber = nil
        local searchQuery = nil
        local updateInstancePropertiesText = nil
        local searchQueryNumber = nil
        local alternateInstancePropertiesNumber = nil
        local updateInstancePropertiesState = nil
        local secondaryUpdateInstancePropertiesState = nil
        local alternateUpdateInstancePropertiesState = nil
        local additionalInstancePropertiesState = nil
        local fallbackUpdateInstancePropertiesState = nil
        local nestedUpdateInstancePropertiesState = nil
        local innerUpdateInstancePropertiesState = nil
        local outerUpdateInstancePropertiesState = nil
        local previousUpdateInstancePropertiesState = nil
        local currentUpdateInstancePropertiesState = nil
        local nextUpdateInstancePropertiesState = nil
        local sourceUpdateInstancePropertiesState = nil
        local additionalInstancePropertiesNumber = 0
        local updateInstancePropertiesData = nil
        local conditionData = nil
        local updateInstancePropertiesFlag = nil
        local flag = nil
        local secondaryUpdateInstancePropertiesFlag = nil
        local alternateUpdateInstancePropertiesFlag = nil
        local additionalUpdateInstancePropertiesFlag = nil
        local text = nil

        repeat
            if additionalInstancePropertiesNumber == 0 then
                updateInstancePropertiesData = {
                    Char = getgenv().Admin_ButtonSample,
                    Title = getgenv().TitleButton,
                    Size = getgenv().SizeButton,
                    Color = getgenv().ColorButton,
                    Shine = getgenv().ShineButton,
                    Re = getgenv().REButton,
                    Height = getgenv().HeightButton,
                    Aura = getgenv().AuraButton,
                    Wormify = getgenv().WormifyButton,
                    Thin = getgenv().ThinButton,
                    Creepify = getgenv().CreepifyButton,
                    Sit = getgenv().SitButton,
                    HideNot = getgenv().HideNotButton,
                    Dog = getgenv().DogButton,
                    FryDance = getgenv().FryDanceButton,
                    Phase = getgenv().PhaseButton,
                    Fat = getgenv().FatButton,
                }
                conditionData = {
                    CharV = getgenv().Admin_LabelSample,
                    TitleV = getgenv().Titleinput,
                    SizeV = getgenv().Sizeinput,
                    HeightV = getgenv().Heightinput,
                }
                additionalInstancePropertiesNumber = 1
            end
        until additionalInstancePropertiesNumber == 1

        local iterator, state, control, _ = pairs(getgenv().AdminsCommandsInfo)

        for key, item in iterator, state do
            updateInstancePropertiesNumber = 0

            while updateInstancePropertiesNumber ~= 0 do end

            number = 0

            while number ~= 0 do end

            if not tostring(key):find('V') then
                while false do end

                local imageColor3 = updateInstancePropertiesData[key]

                if not imageColor3 then
                    updateInstancePropertiesFlag = true
                end
                if not updateInstancePropertiesFlag then
                    searchQuery = imageColor3
                    updateInstancePropertiesText = 'Ticket_Asset'

                    if not imageColor3.FindFirstChild(searchQuery, updateInstancePropertiesText, searchQueryNumber, alternateInstancePropertiesNumber, updateInstancePropertiesState, secondaryUpdateInstancePropertiesState, alternateUpdateInstancePropertiesState, additionalInstancePropertiesState, fallbackUpdateInstancePropertiesState, nestedUpdateInstancePropertiesState, innerUpdateInstancePropertiesState, outerUpdateInstancePropertiesState, previousUpdateInstancePropertiesState) then
                        updateInstancePropertiesFlag = true
                    end
                    if not updateInstancePropertiesFlag then
                        local Ticket_Asset = imageColor3.Ticket_Asset

                        repeat
                            if flag or item ~= true then
                                flag = false
                                updateInstancePropertiesText = 255
                                searchQueryNumber = 0
                                alternateInstancePropertiesNumber = 0
                                searchQuery = Color3.fromRGB(updateInstancePropertiesText, searchQueryNumber, alternateInstancePropertiesNumber)
                                secondaryUpdateInstancePropertiesFlag = true
                            end
                            if secondaryUpdateInstancePropertiesFlag then
                                break
                            end

                            updateInstancePropertiesText = 0
                            searchQueryNumber = 255
                            alternateInstancePropertiesNumber = 0
                            searchQuery = Color3.fromRGB(updateInstancePropertiesText, searchQueryNumber, alternateInstancePropertiesNumber)

                            if not searchQuery then
                                flag = true
                            end
                        until not flag

                        secondaryUpdateInstancePropertiesFlag = false
                        Ticket_Asset.ImageColor3 = searchQuery
                    end
                end
            end

            updateInstancePropertiesFlag = false
            secondaryInstancePropertiesNumber = tostring(key):find('V')

            if secondaryInstancePropertiesNumber then
                secondaryInstancePropertiesNumber = 0

                while secondaryInstancePropertiesNumber ~= 0 do end

                local updateInstancePropertiesCondition = conditionData[key]

                if updateInstancePropertiesCondition then
                    repeat
                        if alternateUpdateInstancePropertiesFlag or item == nil then
                            alternateUpdateInstancePropertiesFlag = false
                            text = ''
                            additionalUpdateInstancePropertiesFlag = true
                        end
                        if additionalUpdateInstancePropertiesFlag then
                            break
                        end

                        searchQuery = item
                        text = tostring(searchQuery)

                        if not text then
                            alternateUpdateInstancePropertiesFlag = true
                        end
                    until not alternateUpdateInstancePropertiesFlag

                    additionalUpdateInstancePropertiesFlag = false
                    updateInstancePropertiesCondition.Text = text
                end
            end
        end

        local visibleNumber = 255
        local fallbackUpdateInstancePropertiesNumber = 0

        if getgenv().HideNotButton.Ticket_Asset.ImageColor3 == Color3.fromRGB(0, visibleNumber, fallbackUpdateInstancePropertiesNumber) and game:GetService('StarterGui'):FindFirstChild('HDAdminInterface', visibleNumber, fallbackUpdateInstancePropertiesNumber) then
            game:GetService('Players').LocalPlayer.PlayerGui.HDAdminInterface.Notices.Visible = false
        end
    end

    updateInstanceProperties()
