    textButtonVariantC.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
        local ipairsResult = nil
        local state = nil
        local name = nil
        local Name = nil
        local secondaryState = nil
        local alternateState = nil
        local additionalState = nil
        local fallbackState = nil
        local nestedState = nil
        local innerState = nil
        local outerState = nil
        local previousState = nil

        while false do end

        ChangeToggleColor(textButtonVariantC)

        if textButtonVariantC.Ticket_Asset.ImageColor3 == Color3.fromRGB(0, 255, 0) then
            local number = 0
            local nameData = nil

            while number ~= 2 do
                if number == 1 then
                    repeat
                        while false do end
                        while false do end

                        wait(0.1)
                        pcall(function()
                            local state = nil
                            local ipairsFunction = ipairs
                            local name = nameData

                            for _, item in ipairsFunction(name), name, state do
                                if LocalPlayer.Character[item.Name].CanCollide then
                                    while false do end
                                    while false do end

                                    task.wait()

                                    LocalPlayer.Character[item.Name].CanCollide = false
                                end
                            end
                        end)
                    until textButtonVariantC.Ticket_Asset.ImageColor3 == Color3.fromRGB(255, 0, 0)

                    local iterator, fallbackState, control, _ = ipairs(nameData)

                    for key, item in iterator, fallbackState do
                        if not LocalPlayer.Character[item.Name].CanCollide then
                            while false do end
                            while false do end

                            task.wait(0.01)

                            local secondaryCharacter = LocalPlayer.Character

                            Name = item.Name
                            name = secondaryCharacter[Name]
                            name.CanCollide = true
                        end
                    end

                    number = 2
                    ipairsResult = v2365
                    state = v2366
                end
                if number == 0 then
                    local secondaryNumber = 0

                    repeat
                        if secondaryNumber == 0 then
                            nameData = {}

                            local secondaryIpairsResult, alternateIpairsResult, additionalIpairsResult, fallbackIpairsResult

                            secondaryIpairsResult, alternateIpairsResult, ipairsResult, additionalIpairsResult, fallbackIpairsResult = ipairs(GetRoot(LocalPlayer).Parent:GetChildren())

                            for key, secondaryName in secondaryIpairsResult, alternateIpairsResult do
                                name = secondaryName
                                Name = 'BasePart'

                                if secondaryName.IsA(name, Name, secondaryState, alternateState, additionalState, fallbackState, nestedState, innerState, outerState, previousState) and secondaryName.CanCollide == true then
                                    local insert = table.insert

                                    name = nameData
                                    Name = secondaryName

                                    insert(name, Name, secondaryState, alternateState, additionalState, fallbackState, nestedState, innerState, outerState, previousState)
                                end
                            end

                            secondaryNumber = 1
                            state = v2373
                        end
                    until secondaryNumber == 1

                    number = 1
                end
            end

            game.Players.LocalPlayer.Character.Humanoid:ChangeState('GettingUp', ipairsResult, state)
        end
    end)

                        if flag or descendant:IsA('ParticleEmitter', numberRangeState, secondaryNumberRangeState, alternateNumberRangeState, additionalNumberRangeState, fallbackNumberRangeState, nestedNumberRangeState) then
                            flag = false
                            numberRange = NumberRange.new(0)

                        else

                            if numberRange then
                                flag = true
                            end
                        end
                    until not flag
                else
                    numberRange = 0

                    while numberRange ~= 0 do end
                    while false do end

                    descendant.Transparency = 1
                    descendant.Texture = ''
                end
            else
                numberRange = 0

                while numberRange ~= 4 do
                    if numberRange == 2 then
                        descendant.BottomSurface = 'SmoothNoOutlines'
                        descendant.FrontSurface = 'SmoothNoOutlines'
                        numberRange = 3
                    end
                    if numberRange == 1 then
                        descendant.Reflectance = 0
                        descendant.BackSurface = 'SmoothNoOutlines'
                        numberRange = 2
                    end
                    if numberRange == 3 then
                        descendant.LeftSurface = 'SmoothNoOutlines'
                        descendant.RightSurface = 'SmoothNoOutlines'
                        numberRange = 4
                    end
                    if numberRange == 0 then
                        descendant.CastShadow = false
                        descendant.Material = 'Plastic'
                        numberRange = 1
                    end
                end

                descendant.TopSurface = 'SmoothNoOutlines'
            end
        end
        for k, descendant in pairs(game:GetService('Lighting'):GetDescendants())do
            if descendant:IsA('PostEffect', numberRangeState, secondaryNumberRangeState, alternateNumberRangeState, additionalNumberRangeState, fallbackNumberRangeState, nestedNumberRangeState) then
                descendant.Enabled = false
            end
        end

                    descendant:Destroy()
                end
            end)
        end, k)

        local state = nil
        local secondaryState = nil

                                    end
                                end
                            end

                            placeId = k
                            text = v

                        alternateNumber = 1
                    end
                end

                secondaryNumber = 2
            end
            if secondaryNumber == 2 then
                break
            end
            if secondaryNumber == 0 then

        secondaryParent.ZIndex = 3
        secondaryParent.Parent = frame

        local uiGradient = Instance.new('UIGradient')

        uiGradient.Color = ColorSequence.new(Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255))
        uiGradient.Transparency = NumberSequence.new({
            NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(0, 1, innerSizeState, outerSizeState, previousSizeState, currentSizeState, nextSizeState, sourceSizeState, targetSizeState, sizeStateVariantA, sizeStateVariantB, sizeStateVariantC, threadState, secondaryThreadState, tweenInfoState, secondaryTweenInfoState),
            NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(0.5, 0.4, outerSizeState, previousSizeState, currentSizeState, nextSizeState, sourceSizeState, targetSizeState, sizeStateVariantA, sizeStateVariantB, sizeStateVariantC, threadState, secondaryThreadState, tweenInfoState, secondaryTweenInfoState, alternateTweenInfoState, additionalTweenInfoState),
            NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(1, 1, previousSizeState, currentSizeState, nextSizeState, sourceSizeState, targetSizeState, sizeStateVariantA, sizeStateVariantB, sizeStateVariantC, threadState, secondaryThreadState, tweenInfoState, secondaryTweenInfoState, alternateTweenInfoState, additionalTweenInfoState, fallbackTweenInfoState, transparencyState),
        })
        uiGradient.Parent = secondaryParent

        local secondaryService = service
        local Create = service.Create
        local alternateParent = frame
        local tweenInfo = TweenInfo.new(0.7, Enum.EasingStyle.Exponential, Enum.EasingDirection.Out, previousSizeState, currentSizeState, nextSizeState, sourceSizeState, targetSizeState, sizeStateVariantA, sizeStateVariantB, sizeStateVariantC, threadState, secondaryThreadState, tweenInfoState, secondaryTweenInfoState, alternateTweenInfoState, additionalTweenInfoState, fallbackTweenInfoState)
        local sizeData = {}
        local threadNumber = 0
        local secondaryThreadNumber = 550
        local alternateThreadNumber = 0
        local additionalThreadNumber = 320
        local size = UDim2.new(threadNumber, secondaryThreadNumber, alternateThreadNumber, additionalThreadNumber, sourceSizeState, targetSizeState, sizeStateVariantA, sizeStateVariantB, sizeStateVariantC, threadState, secondaryThreadState, tweenInfoState, secondaryTweenInfoState, alternateTweenInfoState, additionalTweenInfoState, fallbackTweenInfoState, transparencyState, state, secondaryState, alternateState, additionalState)

        sizeData.Size = size

        local thread = Create(secondaryService, alternateParent, tweenInfo, sizeData, size, threadNumber, secondaryThreadNumber, alternateThreadNumber, additionalThreadNumber, sourceSizeState, targetSizeState, sizeStateVariantA, sizeStateVariantB, sizeStateVariantC, threadState, secondaryThreadState)
        local alternateService = service
        local create = service.Create
        local blurEffect = BlurEffect
        local secondaryTweenInfo = TweenInfo.new(0.7)
        local data = {Size = 24}
        local secondaryResult = create(alternateService, blurEffect, secondaryTweenInfo, data, threadNumber, secondaryThreadNumber, alternateThreadNumber, additionalThreadNumber, sourceSizeState, targetSizeState, sizeStateVariantA, sizeStateVariantB, sizeStateVariantC, threadState, secondaryThreadState, tweenInfoState, secondaryTweenInfoState)

        thread:Play()
        secondaryResult:Play()
        task.delay(0.5, function()
            local tweenInfoState = nil
            local secondaryTweenInfoState = nil
            local alternateTweenInfoState = nil
            local positionState = nil
            local secondaryPositionState = nil
            local alternatePositionState = nil
            local additionalPositionState = nil
            local fallbackPositionState = nil
            local nestedPositionState = nil

            while false do end

            local secondaryService = service
            local create = secondaryService.Create
            local parent = secondaryParent
            local secondaryTweenInfo = TweenInfo.new(1.5, Enum.EasingStyle.Quart, Enum.EasingDirection.InOut, tweenInfoState, secondaryTweenInfoState, alternateTweenInfoState, positionState)
            local data = {}
            local position = UDim2.new(1.2, 0, -0.5, 0, positionState, secondaryPositionState, alternatePositionState, additionalPositionState, fallbackPositionState, nestedPositionState)

            data.Position = position

            create(secondaryService, parent, secondaryTweenInfo, data, position):Play()
        end, data, threadNumber, secondaryThreadNumber, alternateThreadNumber, additionalThreadNumber, sourceSizeState, targetSizeState, sizeStateVariantA, sizeStateVariantB, sizeStateVariantC, threadState, secondaryThreadState, tweenInfoState, secondaryTweenInfoState)
        task.delay(5, function()
            local createConfig = nil
            local size = nil
            local sizeState = nil
            local secondarySizeState = nil
            local alternateSizeState = nil
            local additionalSizeState = nil
            local fallbackSizeState = nil
            local nestedSizeState = nil
            local innerSizeState = nil
            local number = 0
            local secondaryTweenInfo = nil

            while true do
                if number == 0 then
                    local secondaryNumber = 0

                    while secondaryNumber ~= 1 do
                        if secondaryNumber == 0 then
                            secondaryTweenInfo = TweenInfo.new(0.6, Enum.EasingStyle.Back, Enum.EasingDirection.In, createConfig, size)

                            local secondaryService = service
                            local create = secondaryService.Create
                            local parent = frame

                            createConfig = {}

                            local sizeNumber = 0

                            size = UDim2.new(sizeNumber, 0, 0, 0, sizeState, secondarySizeState, alternateSizeState, additionalSizeState, fallbackSizeState, nestedSizeState, innerSizeState)
                            createConfig.Size = size

                            create(secondaryService, parent, secondaryTweenInfo, createConfig, size, sizeNumber):Play()

                            secondaryNumber = 1
                        end
                    end

                    number = 1
                end
                if number == 2 then
                    break
                end
                if number == 1 then
                    service:Create(BlurEffect, secondaryTweenInfo, {Size = 0}, createConfig):Play()
                    task.wait(0.6)

                    number = 2
                end
            end

            ScreenGui:Destroy()
            BlurEffect:Destroy()
        end, data, threadNumber, secondaryThreadNumber, alternateThreadNumber, additionalThreadNumber, sourceSizeState, targetSizeState, sizeStateVariantA, sizeStateVariantB, sizeStateVariantC, threadState, secondaryThreadState, tweenInfoState, secondaryTweenInfoState)
    end)

    return
end

local number = 0
local Sound = nil

while true do
    local secondaryNumber = 0

    while secondaryNumber ~= 1 do
        if secondaryNumber == 0 then
            if number == 3 then
                return
            end
            if number == 1 then
                Sound.SoundId = 'rbxassetid://17692186249'
                Sound.Volume = getgenv().NotifcationVloume
                number = 2
            end

            secondaryNumber = 1
        end
    end

    if number == 0 then
        game:GetService('StarterGui'):SetCore('SendNotification', {
            Title = 'System VR7',
            Text = '\u{62a}\u{645} \u{62a}\u{641}\u{639}\u{64a}\u{644} \u{627}\u{644}\u{633}\u{643}\u{631}\u{628}\u{62a} \u{645}\u{633}\u{628}\u{642}\u{627}\u{60c} \u{627}\u{639}\u{62f} \u{627}\u{644}\u{62f}\u{62e}\u{648}\u{644} \u{644}\u{62a}\u{634}\u{63a}\u{64a}\u{644}\u{647} \u{645}\u{62c}\u{62f}\u{62f}\u{627}',
            Duration = 5,
        })

        Sound = Instance.new('Sound', game.Workspace)
        number = 1
    end
    if number == 2 then
        Sound.Ended:Connect(function()
            Sound:Destroy()
        end)
        Sound:Play()

        number = 3
    end
end
